visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with glasses and a white t-shirt smiles broadly at the camera while holding two glasses of brightly colored juice—one vibrant green and one deep orange—in a sunlit kitchen with a wooden table surface. (2) The scene transitions to the woman opening a modern refrigerator door, from which she retrieves fresh kale, a red apple, and a cucumber, holding them up to show the camera before moving to the sink. (3) At a stainless steel sink, she places the produce in a white perforated colander and washes the kale, apple, and cucumber thoroughly under a stream of running water, ensuring each item is rinsed clean. (4) On a thick wooden cutting board, she uses a sharp knife to cut the cucumber, kale, and apple into smaller segments, with the bowl of fresh ingredients resting nearby in the background. (5) She introduces a beige and black Hurom cold press juicer on the countertop, placing the prepared green ingredients into the top chute and watching as the machine begins to process the fruits and vegetables. (6) Vibrant green juice is shown pouring from the juicer's spout into a clear plastic container, while a tiny digital version of the woman appears to sneeze and play around the juice stream. (7) Switching to a second recipe, she chops carrots and ginger on the same board, then adds them along with turmeric powder and lemon wedges into the juicer's hopper for processing. (8) Rich orange juice flows out of the machine into a pitcher; the woman is seen holding up the final glasses of juice, clinking one against another glass held by an off-screen person.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice says "是我目前最有感的身體投資" over a mid-tempo, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a bright, clean tone. The acoustic environment sounds like a quiet, treated indoor space with high clarity. (2) A mechanical click and rustling sound indicate a refrigerator opening, followed by the female voice greeting with "Ciao!" and explaining her daily routine of ensuring she consumes enough fruits and vegetables in a friendly tone. (3) Distinct splashing and flowing water sounds are heard as she washes the ingredients, layered with the continuous, positive background music that maintains a steady rhythmic beat throughout the sequence. (4) Sharp, rhythmic thudding sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board occur as she lists the ingredients, with the voice maintaining a narrative and professional broadcast quality, enunciating clearly for the audience. (5) The mechanical whirring of a juicer motor enters the mix, a low-frequency hum that accompanies her mentioning the brand name "Hurom" while the music continues to provide a cheerful melodic backdrop. (6) Liquid pouring sounds with a characteristic "glug" texture are heard as the green juice is extracted, accompanied by a cartoonish "sneezing" sound effect that adds a comedic, variety-show element to the audio track. (7) More rhythmic chopping sounds and the juicer's mechanical hum return as she prepares the carrot and ginger mix, with the vocal delivery becoming more informative and encouraging about the health benefits. (8) The video concludes with a sharp, metallic "clink" sound effect of two glasses touching, followed by a final cheerful vocal sign-off "綠啾絲Juice" as the music swells slightly before fading out.
